instructions: The night before, or at least 4 hours ahead: peel the 4 bananas, slice them into coins and freeze them in a sealed bag.
In the morning, put 2 cups of the frozen berries, half the banana coins and 1/4 cup of the almond milk in a blender.
Blend on low, stopping to scrape down the sides with a spatula, until it's thick and smooth like soft serve. Add another splash of almond milk only if the blades stall.
Blend the last 2 cups berries, the rest of the banana and the last 1/4 cup almond milk the same way, and scoop it into 2 more bowls.
Top the bowls with the 1/2 cup granola, 1/4 cup coconut, 1/4 cup chia seeds, 1/4 cup hemp seeds and the blueberries, dividing them evenly.
advance_prep_notes: Slice and freeze the bananas the night before (at least 4 hours ahead).
method_notes: All three read versions blend frozen berries until thick enough to eat with a spoon and pile toppings on top. Minimalist Baker (the lead) uses a heaping cup of frozen berries and a small frozen banana per bowl with only a few tablespoons of coconut or almond milk, blends on low and scrapes down until it's like soft serve, then tops it with coconut, chia and hemp seeds, granola and fruit. Spend With Pennies adds yogurt and more milk, and Love and Lemons swaps the banana for almond butter, spinach and ice. This one makes the lead's bowl four times in two blender batches.
